payload.text: hv, 18 Oct, directly to vc, answering vc's questions. At 19:16Z: (1) yes, menuz's floor moves from macOS 14 to 26 for 0073, since ArcaMasthead needs macOS 26 and Swift 6.2; (2) main goes upstream after dc's kovacs run of tests.yml's Linux loop and the shellcheck step under 0.9.0, then hv pushes; (3) the next release is cut after 0073 lands; (4) 0073 sets menuz 0.4.0. At 19:32Z: (5) ic's roster row reads "Interface Claude: menuz's front end and its adoption of arca_swift (0073 now, 0072 after arca_swift's WP-09); takes its instructions from vc", which cc writes; (6) wip.md's TODO on a second notification request under the first-launch alert is dropped. The release NUMBER is 2.14.1: hv told cc "2.14.1" at 19:13Z (cc's decision 3) and typed "2.14.1" to vc at 19:16:57Z, while vc's two pickers read 2.15.0 at 19:16Z and 19:32Z. vc takes the typed word, which the CHANGELOG heading already carries, so nothing is retitled; hv's one word changes it before the cut. dc's doctor floor check (dc's decision 1, on hv's "Go with your recs") goes into 0073's design.
